about: Which ledger files to delete because their account is no longer registered (spec flow-cli-core 1.2 'Removing an account'; flow usage prune, and DorkOS when an account is removed). Call pruneTargets(registered, onDisk). input.registered maps each runtime to its account ids (an implicit 'default' may be among them); input.onDisk maps each runtime to the ids that have a <id>.json ledger file. A missing runtime reads as []. expected.remove maps every runtime (claude-code, codex, opencode) to the ids to delete, in onDisk order: every id on disk that is not registered for that runtime, except 'default', which is never deleted (it belongs to the runtime's implicit account and comes back whenever the registry empties). A file is deleted under its lock; a missing file is not an error.

cases.name: an unregistered account's file goes; registered ones stay
default is never removed, even when the runtime has registered accounts
the same id is judged per runtime
